title: KnowledgeEntryFrontmatter
description: Machine-checkable schema for the YAML frontmatter of a knowledge/entries/<id>.md file. See schema.md for the human-readable version.

id.description: Stable kebab-case slug; must match filename minus .md.

source_tier.description: Authority of the evidence behind this entry (Spine calibration gate). T1/T2 = primary/official source or directly-reproduced behavior; T3 = secondary/community source; T4 = orientation only, never a claim basis; TX = rejected material. Set to the lowest-authority source that materially contributed. See agents/reviewer.md's calibration gate and src/calibration.js.
